messages:
alex: FYI PR #18321 CI microbench failed on staging — batcher slotter latency +7.6% on 1k-seq tests. Holding rollout.
ci-bot: benchmark-checker: perf-diff exceeded threshold for perf/microbatch/slotter: +7.6% (threshold +3%). See: https://ci/reports/18321 :warning:
riley: ugh. slotter? that's the kernel selector that shards batches, right? any stack? :eyes:
alex: yep. stack traces point to kernel_selector::choose_slotter() change in commit abcdef4 from PR-18290 (recent merge) — changed fallback heuristics.
sam: I can repro locally on my laptop with repo@abcdef4. Running microbench.sh gives similar numbers. attaching snippet:
```
microbench: slotter_profile
seq=1024 iters=1000 mean=12.3ms -> 13.2ms (+7.3%)
95th=18.9ms -> 20.6ms
heap: slotter score loop hot
```
riley: can we bisect to narrow commits between abcdef0 and abcdef4? I'll kick off a bisect job.
ci-bot: bisect-runner: started job bisect-559 against range abcdef0..abcdef4. ETA ~20m.
sam: flamegraph: https://perf/reports/fg/18321 (hotpath: slotter::score() -> memcpy / kernel cost model)
alex: interesting — score() now computes an L2 penalty per kernel; that loop is O(n_kernels) and got heavier after adding quant-candidate checks in the inner loop.
maria: if bisect shows abcdef2 as culprit, recommend reverting that change for rollback. We can't absorb +7% tail latency for production workloads.
riley: bisect result: first-bad=abcdef2 (adds quant candidate branch into score path). reproduce command: `./ci/microbench --profile slotter --iters 1000`
sam: confirming: reverting abcdef2 locally drops latency back to baseline. I'll open a hotfix PR to revert and run full perf CI.
alex: thanks. also please add a perf unit to catch slotter O(n * m) behavior: harness with varied kernel count and seqlen to avoid regressions.
maria: :thumbsup: also place a rollout hold on the merge until hotfix lands and perf passes.
ci-bot: PR 18335 opened: revert abcdef2 -> https://ci/pull/18335. Triggered: perf/unit + microbench suite.
riley: follow-up idea: cache quant-candidates or precompute candidate set outside the hot score loop to avoid repeated work.
sam: I'll prototype a small TTL cache and benchmark impact.
alex: okay — keep rollout on hold until CI shows no perf regression. Thanks everyone, will close the loop once PR 18335 is merged and golden-run completes.
